targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', symbol) AS metric, CAST(spread_bps AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${symbol:csv}' = '$__all' OR symbol IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${symbol:csv}', ','))) AND spread_bps IS NOT NULL AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY 1

SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', symbol, ':vwap') AS metric, CAST(vwap AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${symbol:csv}' = '$__all' OR symbol IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${symbol:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', symbol, ':mid_price') AS metric, CAST(avg_mid_price AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${symbol:csv}' = '$__all' OR symbol IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${symbol:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS ( SELECT metric_ts, exchange, symbol, CAST(close AS FLOAT64) AS close_px, AVG(CAST(close AS FLOAT64)) OVER (PARTITION BY metric_ts, symbol) AS avg_close_px FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${symbol:csv}' = '$__all' OR symbol IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${symbol:csv}', ','))) AND close IS NOT NULL AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ) SELECT TIMESTAMP(metric_ts) AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':', symbol) AS metric, SAFE_DIVIDE(close_px - avg_close_px, avg_close_px) * 10000 AS value FROM base ORDER BY 1
